description: Rewrite a 1.x extension.toml as manifest 2.0: compatibility.bsh becomes host, runtime fields move under runtime.config, contributes lists become [[contribution]] entries, events/publishes/hooks become contributions. Pass write=true to replace the manifest and keep a .v1 backup.

path.description: Absolute path to the package directory.

write.description: Write the migrated manifest instead of only returning it.
